caseName: Crawford County Bar Ass'n v. Faubus
caseNameFull: CRAWFORD COUNTY BAR ASSOCIATION v. FAUBUS, GOVERNOR OF ARKANSAS
attorneys: Fines F. Batchelor, Jr., for appellant in No. 941. W. B. Brady for appellant in No. 942., Bruce Bennett, Attorney General of Arkansas, F-arrell E. Faubus, Assistant Attorney General, and Jack L. Lessenberry for appellees in both cases.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.

Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.
